reasons: Totals are worked out in two different ways on the same screen.
A missing median is shown as zero in totals but as a midpoint in rows.

terms.meaning: Two cost measures shown here in dollars per kWdc. The code does not spell out what each stands for, so check the model documentation.
The middle value of a range, used here as the single headline figure.
A minimum and a maximum for one cost.
Kilowatts of panel (DC) capacity and kilowatts of grid-side (AC) capacity.
A library that draws bar and pie charts from data.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for results screen
sections.what: Brings in the animation library, the chart pieces, icons, the store, and the data types for cost ranges.
sections.why: Charts need several separate pieces, so each one is named here.

sections.name: fmt
sections.title: Dollar formatting helper
sections.what: Turns a number into a dollar amount with two decimal places and thousands separators.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps every money figure on the screen in one consistent style.
sections.watch_out: The dollar sign is fixed, while the thousands separators follow the browser's language setting.

sections.name: ResultsPanel (part 1)
sections.title: Cost rows and summary figures
sections.what: Builds the list of cost rows and the chart data, using the median of each range. Works out the MMP total by adding component medians, computes AC size as system size divided by the DC to AC ratio, and draws the four summary cards.
sections.why: Likely reason: building the rows once lets the charts, tables and totals reuse the same numbers.
sections.watch_out: The MMP total card is worked out here from the rows, not taken from the backend total, so it may not match the table's total row.

sections.name: ResultsPanel (part 2)
sections.title: Bar and pie charts
sections.what: Draws a bar chart comparing MSP and MMP for each component, and a pie chart of the MSP share for each component. Pie slices get a label only when they are above 3 percent.
sections.why: Likely reason: hiding labels on tiny slices keeps the pie readable.
sections.watch_out: Slices under 3 percent have no label, so the reader must use the tooltip or the table to find small items.

sections.name: ResultsPanel (part 3)
sections.title: Detailed tables and run details
sections.what: Draws the detailed PV only cost table, adds a separate PV plus storage table when storage is on, and shows a run details block with the calculation time, session ID, and whether storage was included.
sections.why: Gives the detail behind the summary and shows which run is on screen.
sections.watch_out: The time and session ID come straight from the backend, and a missing timestamp shows as an invalid date.

sections.name: CostTable
sections.title: Cost table drawing
sections.what: Draws a table with one row per component showing the MSP minimum, maximum, and median and the MMP minimum, maximum, and median. A total row shows the backend total and the formula text.
sections.why: Likely reason: the total row uses the backend's own figure, so the user sees the calculation's stated total.
sections.watch_out: A missing median in the total row shows as $0.00 rather than an error.

sections.name: MetricCardProps
sections.title: Summary card settings shape
sections.what: Describes one summary card: its title, value text, subtitle, icon, and trend setting.
sections.why: Keeps the four summary cards built the same way.

sections.name: MetricCard
sections.title: Summary card drawing
sections.what: Draws one summary card with a title, large value, small note, and icon, and slightly enlarges it on hover.
sections.why: Likely reason: one card style makes the headline figures easy to scan.
sections.watch_out: The trend setting only changes the icon colour; it does not show a rise or a fall, despite its name.

sections.name: CostRowProps
sections.title: Cost row settings shape
sections.what: Describes one table row: the component name and its MSP and MMP ranges.
sections.why: Keeps every table row built from the same information.

sections.name: CostRow
sections.title: Cost row drawing
sections.what: Draws one component row with the MSP and MMP minimum, maximum, and median, with the medians highlighted in red.
sections.why: Likely reason: the medians are the headline figures, so they are emphasised.
sections.watch_out: If the backend sends no median, this row calculates a midpoint, which can hide that the value was missing.

summary: The results screen: four summary cards, a bar chart and a pie chart, a detailed cost table for the PV only case, an optional table for storage, and run details.
purpose: Shows what the model calculated in a form the user can compare and drill into.
why: Likely reason: summary cards give the headline figures first, while tables and charts let the user check the detail.
how: Reads outputs and inputs from the store and builds a list of cost rows: modules, inverters, structural BOS, electrical BOS, field labor, office labor, other, and O&M. Storage is added when it is on. For each row it takes the median of each range, or the midpoint of the minimum and maximum if no median exists. It then draws the summary cards, the bar chart, the pie chart, the cost tables, and the run details.
inputs: outputs and inputs from the store, which come from the most recent calculation.
outputs: Cards, charts, and tables on screen. No data is sent anywhere from this file.
risks: The MMP total card adds the component medians itself, so it can differ from the total in the backend table. Missing medians become zero in the table totals.
debug: If totals look wrong, compare the table's total row with the MMP card. If they differ, the card's own sum of medians is the likely source. If charts are empty, check that outputs has the expected component entries. If the storage table is missing, check that both storage outputs are present.
